claim: Try a realistic six-topic route in one click without changing your real plan.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter from the landing in one click at 1440x900 and 390x844; assert the populated workspace and route summary fit the first viewport; verify isolated edits, reset, and exit

claim: Opening the 404 page leaves the complete saved plan unchanged.
sandbox: fresh real-planner context; create and save a two-topic plan; record its exact storage value; open the product 404; return to the planner; assert the stored bytes and rendered plan are unchanged

claim: Planner content stays in browser storage, and ordinary planning sends no data to third parties or trackers.
where: landing facts, planner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; edit and reload; record every request; assert persisted demo data and same-origin requests only

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; open /demo; wait for service-worker control; set context offline; reload and assert the sample route

claim: A returning visitor receives the current app version, and the replaced version still reloads offline.
sandbox: dedicated browser context and isolated local server; install the exact legacy worker, replace the served distribution, request an update, assert the current bundle and cache, then reload offline

claim: Exports the complete study route as CSV without payment.
where: landing facts, planner toolbar, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; attach a labelled HTTPS practice reference to Control systems; download CSV; assert its exact header, one row for each of six topics, only the selected prerequisite, and both practice label and URL

claim: Backs up and restores a complete plan as JSON.
where: landing facts, planner toolbar, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download backup; replace the route with a template; restore the downloaded bytes; assert all topics and a practice reference return

claim: Turns pasted syllabus headings into a study route, removes duplicates, and orders lower-confidence topics first.
where: landing headline, setup form, route overview, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; clear sample; paste numbered and bulleted headings with a duplicate; build; change confidence; assert deduplication and reordered topics

claim: Provides three editable starter templates at no cost.
sandbox: fresh real-planner context; choose every template; assert its editable topics and local-only storage

claim: Starter templates are editable plans, not official syllabuses.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; select a starter template; assert its no-official-syllabus boundary, blank source URL, editable topic controls, and demo-only storage

claim: Exam Bridge does not host exam questions or coaching notes.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; inspect the supplied practice data and requests; assert the sample contains references only, no question-text editor or coaching-note content, and no content-service request

claim: Exam Bridge is not endorsed by any exam authority.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert the independent-tool boundary is visible and the product shell loads no authority branding, authority login, or authority-service request

claim: The landing illustration is an original generated illustration.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert the displayed artwork is the documented same-origin asset and its shipped provenance record identifies an original generated source

claim: The planner, templates, CSV exports, and JSON backups are free and require no account, card, checkout, or payment.
where: landing facts, templates panel, Terms, README
sandbox: fresh context; build a real plan; use a template; download CSV and JSON; assert every control stays enabled without account, card, payment, checkout, or cross-origin request

claim: Checkout is unavailable and disabled, and Exam Bridge makes no checkout request.
sandbox: fresh real-planner context; assert the unavailable checkout control is disabled, no paid tier or price is promised, and no checkout URL or cross-origin request exists

claim: Supports keyboard use, light and dark themes, reduced motion, 44-pixel targets, and a 390-pixel screen.
sandbox: fresh /demo context at 390x844 with reduced motion; use skip link by keyboard; scan both themes with axe; assert no overflow and every visible target is at least 44px

claim: New plans accept 2 to 80 distinct topics and never save topic 81.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; clear sample; create 80 topics; assert Add topic is disabled, storage remains at 80, backup works, and reload keeps all 80
